The '''Pelratha Mesa''' was a [[mesa]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]]. In [[3638 BBY]] it collapsed when [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] forces attempted to stabilize the planet's core by deep drilling.
